@@info: Keys that exist in <en> but not in <uk>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with uk translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/uk.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
equalizer_device_peq_info_overview_seria: USB Serial — for devices exposing a CDC / virtual COM interface (JDS Labs, Nothing, FiiO, and more), including Bluetooth serial ports.
equalizer_device_peq_info_howto_step_1: Click Connect USB device, or pick another connection under it (USB serial, Bluetooth or Network).
equalizer_device_peq_info_howto_step_2: Approve the device in the browser's permission prompt. It is matched against the eqcaps EQ database, which knows its limits; if several devices fit, you'll be asked which one it is. For Network devices, enter the device IP address.
equalizer_device_peq_info_howto_step_3: While connected, the device's limits are the active EQ constraint: bands it can't hold are marked, and Fit moves them onto values it accepts. Pick a preset if the device has several.
equalizer_device_peq_info_howto_step_4: Use Read from device to load its current EQ into the band list, or Write to device to send yours. If the device can't hold your EQ exactly, you'll see what changes before anything is written.
equalizer_device_peq_info_howto_step_5: Click Disconnect when you're done. Some devices restart after saving; click Reconnect to carry on.
eq_constraint_select_title: EQ constraint — limit the bands to what a device or app accepts
eq_constraint_load_failed: Couldn't load {label}. Check your connection and try again.
eq_constraint_draft_title: Unverified limits: not yet checked against the real device or app
eq_constraint_catalog_failed: The EQ database can't be reached. The built-in presets still work.
eq_constraint_past_max_bands: Past the {max}-band limit of {label}. Remove a band or change the constraint to edit it.
eq_constraint_type_violation: {label} doesn't accept this filter type here
eq_constraint_fit_title: Move every band onto the nearest values {label} accepts. Undoable.
equalizer_device_peq_choose_prompt: Several devices fit. Which one is this?
equalizer_device_peq_unsupported: This device isn't in the EQ database yet.
equalizer_device_peq_guess_notice: Not in the EQ database: connected on its maker's usual protocol, with limits from what that protocol can carry. Experimental.
equalizer_device_peq_group_notice: Matched a profile shared by several devices; your exact model isn't listed.
equalizer_device_peq_draft_notice: These limits haven't been checked on a real device yet.
equalizer_device_peq_experimental: Support for this device is experimental.
equalizer_device_peq_read_title: Replace the band list with the device's EQ
equalizer_device_peq_write_title: Send the band list to the device
equalizer_device_peq_write_only: This device can be written to but not read back.
equalizer_device_peq_read_skipped: {count} band(s) use filter types the equalizer can't show and were left out.
equalizer_device_peq_status_saved_reconn: Saved. The device restarts after saving; reconnect to carry on.
equalizer_device_peq_status_reconnect_ma: Couldn't find the device again. Plug it in and connect.
equalizer_device_peq_push_intro: The device can't hold this EQ exactly as shown. This is what it will get:
equalizer_device_peq_push_dropped: Band {band}: no slot left on the device, not sent
equalizer_device_peq_push_skipped_channe: {count} left/right-only band(s) not sent: the device has one EQ for both ears
equalizer_device_peq_push_clip_risk: These bands boost, and this device's level can't be lowered from here. Turn the volume down or reduce the boost to avoid clipping.
equalizer_device_peq_push_infeasible: Some bands still break one of the device's rules (band order or spacing), so it may reject them.
device_peq_error_timeout: The device didn't answer. Check the cable and try again.
device_peq_error_transport: Lost the connection to the device.
device_peq_error_bad_response: The device answered with something unexpected.
device_peq_error_unrepresentable: A value can't be sent to this device.
device_peq_error_generic: Something went wrong talking to the device.
